item.description:
TMDB metadata and trailers now resolve same-title, same-year films and shows when the playlist supplies a matching trusted TMDB poster. The app compares exact poster gallery assets across verified candidates and uses only one unambiguous match; unrelated years and remakes remain separate.
Supports regional TMDB poster URL presets such as w600_and_h900_bestv2. The matching rule is shared by details and artwork, and Home uses the same poster-aware cache identity. Previous no-match entries are refreshed with the new matching version.
Once selected, descriptions and cast appear independently from optional trailer loading. Existing language fallback still loads an English trailer when the requested language has none.
Validation: 253 focused checks passed; 2 optional catalogue/timing audits were skipped. Live acceptance using the actual regional Alice in Wonderland (2010) poster resolved the Disney film, metadata, images and trailer in approximately 0.62 seconds in one test. Timing varies by network and cache state. No movie-specific ID exception was added to production code.
Apple Silicon, macOS 14+. Owner-approved development-signed, unnotarized release. No personal playlists or provider credentials are bundled.
